start: Live workout, tap add exercise: the exercise picker

steps.action: Look at the list before typing
user_sees: Search box 'Search exercises' (or 'Search <n> exercises'), 'All equipment' and 'All muscles' buttons, a 'Recent' band, then all exercises A to Z
must_not: Hidden exercises in the list
A blank list while exercises load (grey placeholder rows show)

steps.action: Type 'bench'
user_sees: The list follows a beat behind; best match at the top, scrolled to the top
must_not: Letters dropped from the box while typing
The best match left scrolled out of sight

steps.action: Tap 'All muscles', pick Chest in the 'Muscle' sheet
user_sees: Only chest exercises; the button now reads 'Chest'
must_not: Recent band still shown while a filter is on

steps.action: Tap an exercise
user_sees: It is added to the workout
must_not: The same exercise added twice from one tap

steps.action: Open the library list
user_sees: Bands: Recent (done, newest first, 'Last: <date>'), Made by you, All exercises
must_not: An exercise listed in two bands at once without reason

steps.action: Scroll to the end
user_sees: 'Hidden exercises' link after the results
must_not: Hidden exercises mixed into the main list

start: Exercise picker, typed name not in the library (for example 'Zercher lunge')

steps.action: Look under the results
user_sees: 'Did you mean <nearest>?' above a 'Create “Zercher lunge”' row
must_not: The Create row offered for a name that already exists

steps.action: Tap 'Create “Zercher lunge”' (or the header create button)
user_sees: The new-exercise screen opens with the name filled in
must_not: The typed name lost

start: Exercise picker, small picture on a row

steps.action: Tap an exercise's small picture
user_sees: Its how-to sheet opens (F-phone-711) without adding the exercise
must_not: The exercise added to the workout by the picture tap

start: Exercise picker, a search with no match and no create offer (filter on)

steps.action: Type 'xyzq' with Chest filter on
user_sees: 'No exercises found' - 'Try a different search, muscle or gear.'
must_not: An endless loading state
A crash

start: Exercise picker when the phone database read fails

steps.action: Open the picker when the read fails
user_sees: A load error naming 'your exercises' with a retry button
must_not: An empty list that looks like no exercises exist

steps.action: Tap retry
user_sees: The list loads
must_not: The error staying after a good retry

start: Library list, an exercise the member hid

steps.action: Hide an exercise, go back to the picker
user_sees: It is gone from search and from Recent
must_not: The hidden exercise still offered in Recent

steps.action: Open 'Hidden exercises' and unhide it
user_sees: It is back in the list
must_not: It stays hidden after unhiding

steps.action: Create an exercise and search
user_sees: The member's own exercises stay on this phone (and their own cloud copy when signed in)
must_not: The member's own exercise names shown to the gym or other members
